title: Druqks for the Dancefloor
description: A gritty, bass-led roller that detonates early and then comes apart at the seams. A rolling sub-bassline mutates under crushed, glitchy textures over a broken half-time 808 kit, ratcheting into a dense peak before deconstructing into delay-soaked rubble.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(280).gain(0.6),
    s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).degradeBy(0.4).cut(1)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.1).every(8, x => x.ply("<1 1 2 4>")),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(340).gain(0.62).crush(8),
    s("hh(5,8)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("~ cp").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.7).room(0.2)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.15).every(4, x => x.ply("<1 1 2 4>")),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(420).gain(0.65).shape(0.3),
    note("c2(3,8) eb2 g1").s("jvbass").gain(0.6).crush(6).lpf(900),
    s("hh(7,8)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    s("~ cp ~ [cp cp]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.7).room(0.2),
    note("<eb4 g4 c5>").s("casio").n(1).gain(0.45).crush(7).delay(".4:.1875:.5")
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd(3,8)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.2).ply("<1 2 2 4>"),
    note("<c1 eb1 g0 c1>*8").s("sine").lpf(520).gain(0.66).shape(0.4).crush(6),
    note("c2*4").s("jvbass").gain(0.62).crush(5).shape(0.3).lpf(1100),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.5).cut(1).degradeBy(0.2).pan(sine.range(0.2,0.8)),
    s("sd(3,8,2)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.6).crush(8),
    s("metal*4").gain(0.4).crush(5).delay(".3:.125:.4").degradeBy(0.5)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*2").s("sine").lpf(360).gain(0.6).shape(0.5).crush(4).delay(".5:.25:.6"),
    s("bd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.0).delay(".4:.1875:.5"),
    note("<eb4 g4>").s("casio").n(1).gain(0.4).crush(8).delay(".6:.25:.7"),
    s("metal ~ ~ metal").gain(0.4).crush(6).delay(".5:.1875:.6").degradeBy(0.3)
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.2).every(2, x => x.ply("<2 4>")),
    note("<c1 eb1 g0 c1>*8").s("sine").lpf(560).gain(0.68).shape(0.5).crush(7),
    note("c2(5,8) eb2 g1").s("jvbass").gain(0.64).crush(5).shape(0.4).lpf(1300),
    s("hh(7,8)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.55).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15).ply("<1 1 2>"),
    s("~ cp ~ [cp cp cp]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.7).room(0.2),
    s("sd(5,8,3)").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.55).crush(8),
    note("<eb4 g4 c5 bb4>").s("casio").n(1).gain(0.45).crush(8).delay(".4:.125:.5")
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ [~ bd] ~").bank("RolandTR808").gain(1.05).delay(".4:.1875:.4").degradeBy(0.1),
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(300).gain(0.6).crush(6).delay(".3:.125:.3"),
    s("hh*2").bank("RolandTR808").gain(0.4).cut(1).degradeBy(0.5).delay(".5:.25:.5")
  )]
)
